summary.headline: Eclipse Effects and the King’s Significator
summary.text: Eclipse prognostication assigns effects according to the eclipse lord, the king’s significator, fortunes and infortunes, the Sun’s arrival at the eclipse ascendant or midheaven, and the ascending sign’s human, animal, or watery symbolism. It also gives time measures for lunar and solar eclipses and locates impediments by the ascendant, midheaven, or west in relation to Jupiter, Mercury, Saturn, the Moon, Mars, and Venus; Chapter 41 then begins on the Sun as significator of the king.
